items.statement: Higher triplet states couple more strongly to S1 than T1 does in a complete outcome.
items.expected: For status complete, S1/T6 and S1/T7 SOC magnitudes both exceed S1/T1; this conclusion is not applied to status limited.

For status complete, the large S1-T1 separation and stronger S1 coupling to T6/T7 support a higher-triplet-mediated access interpretation and make direct T1-to-S1 thermal access less favorable, without claiming a rate or unique mechanism. For status limited, the conclusion states that interpretation is unresolved because of the reported failed validation and missing observables.
